<?php
// Create sample content for the sitemap demo
$sample_posts = array(
    array(
        'title' => 'Welcome to Our Demo Site',
        'content' => 'This is a sample post showcasing the 10up Sitemaps plugin functionality. The sitemap will include this post along with other content types.'
    ),
    array(
        'title' => 'Getting Started with WordPress',
        'content' => 'Learn the basics of WordPress and how to get your site up and running quickly with our comprehensive guide.'
    ),
    array(
        'title' => 'SEO Best Practices',
        'content' => 'Discover the essential SEO techniques that will help your WordPress site rank better in search engines.'
    )
);

foreach ($sample_posts as $post_data) {
    wp_insert_post(array(
        'post_title'    => $post_data['title'],
        'post_content'  => $post_data['content'],
        'post_status'   => 'publish',
        'post_author'   => 1,
        'post_type'     => 'post'
    ));
}

// Create sample pages
$sample_pages = array(
    array(
        'title' => 'About Us',
        'content' => 'Learn more about our company and what we do.'
    ),
    array(
        'title' => 'Contact',
        'content' => 'Get in touch with us for any questions or support.'
    ),
    array(
        'title' => 'Services',
        'content' => 'Explore the services we offer to help grow your business.'
    )
);

foreach ($sample_pages as $page_data) {
    wp_insert_post(array(
        'post_title'    => $page_data['title'],
        'post_content'  => $page_data['content'],
        'post_status'   => 'publish',
        'post_author'   => 1,
        'post_type'     => 'page'
    ));
}

// Create categories
$categories = array('Technology', 'Business', 'Marketing');
foreach ($categories as $cat_name) {
    wp_create_category($cat_name);
}

// Create tags
$tags = array('WordPress', 'SEO', 'Demo', 'Sitemap');
foreach ($tags as $tag_name) {
    wp_insert_term($tag_name, 'post_tag');
}

// Flush rewrite rules to ensure sitemap URLs work properly
flush_rewrite_rules();

// Generate the sitemap using the plugin's functionality
if (function_exists('tenup_sitemaps_generate_sitemap')) {
    tenup_sitemaps_generate_sitemap();
} elseif (class_exists('TenUp\\Sitemaps\\Sitemaps')) {
    $sitemaps = new TenUp\\Sitemaps\\Sitemaps();
    if (method_exists($sitemaps, 'generate_sitemap')) {
        $sitemaps->generate_sitemap();
    }
}

// Also try to trigger sitemap generation via WordPress hooks
if (function_exists('do_action')) {
    do_action('tenup_sitemaps_generate_sitemap');
}
?>
